messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that focus on global warming and climate change:

| Title | Release Year | Director | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|----------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Davis Guggenheim | Former Vice President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change and urges action. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | Davis Guggenheim | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and highlights new challenges. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Fisher Stevens | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to meet scientists, activists, and leaders about the impacts of climate change. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | Various | A concise overview of the science, impacts, and solutions to climate change. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Leila Conners | A global look at environmental degradation and potential solutions, featuring many experts. |

If you’re looking for something more recent or a specific aspect (e.g., impacts on polar regions, policy responses), let me know and I can narrow it down further!
